title: CUSTOMS AGENCY LICENSE 2025 - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# CUSTOMS AGENCY LICENSE 2025
Pursuant to Section 145 (1) of the East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004 (as amended) and Regulation 149 – 152 of the East African Community Customs Management Regulations, 2010, the Commissioner Customs of the Uganda Revenue Authority invites new applicants and applications for renewal of Customs Agency Licenses for the Year 2025.
The applications form (form No. C20), licensing conditions and assessment forms are accessible via https://singlewindow.go.ug/stp/#/
All applicants are advised to ensure that their application forms are duly filled. All relevant information and documents as required on the Electronic Single Window platform should be availed, scanned and uploaded to https://singlewindow.go.ug/stp/#/
The deadline for submission is October 01, 2024 .
Authorised Economic Operators (AEO) companies will only be required to submit applications for automatic renewal of their Customs Agency License subject to payment of the requisite fees.
The activities related to licensing will be conducted strictly within the timelines below;
Activity
Receiving Applications and payment of Application fee
01 st September 2024 – 01 st October 2024
Competence test for Declarants
16 th October 2024
Vetting applications
01 st September 2024 – 01 st November 2024
Final verification and payment of License Fee
01 st September 2024 – 31 st December 2024
Closing date for Issuance of Licenses
31 st December 2024
Appeals for review
16 th October 2024 – 16 th November 2024
Uploading of Licensed companies on the URA Portal
30 th December 2024
First date of Publication: Saturday August 17, 2024
MANAGEMENT
